raw: Act 4, Scene 4 — Hall in Capulet’s House

sentences.en: Hall in Capulet’s House

summary.en: Early in the morning, the Capulet house gets ready for the wedding.
summary.ko: 이른 아침, 캐퓰릿 집안은 결혼식 준비로 바쁘다.

raw: Enter Lady Capulet and Nurse.

speaker: LADY CAPULET
raw: Hold, take these keys and fetch more spices, Nurse.

sentences.en: Here, take these keys and get more spices, Nurse.
sentences.ko: 여기 이 열쇠를 가지고 가서 향신료를 더 가져오너라, 유모.

speaker: NURSE
raw: They call for dates and quinces in the pastry.

sentences.en: They want dates and quinces in the pastry.
sentences.ko: 주방에서 과자에 넣을 대추와 모과를 달래요.

raw: Enter Capulet.

speaker: CAPULET
raw:
Come, stir, stir, stir! The second cock hath crow’d,
The curfew bell hath rung, ’tis three o’clock.
Look to the bak’d meats, good Angelica;
Spare not for cost.

sentences.en: Come, stir, stir, stir, because the second rooster has crowed!
sentences.ko: 자, 어서 움직여, 움직여! 두 번째 닭이 울었다!

sentences.en: The church bell has rung and it is three o'clock.
sentences.ko: 교회 종이 울렸고 벌써 세 시다.

sentences.en: Check on the baked meats, Angelica, and do not worry about the cost.
sentences.ko: 안젤리카, 고기 굽는 것 좀 살펴봐. 돈은 아끼지 말고.

speaker: NURSE
raw:
Go, you cot-quean, go,
Get you to bed; faith, you’ll be sick tomorrow
For this night’s watching.

sentences.en: Go, you old housewife, go.
Go to bed.
I promise you will be sick tomorrow.
You will be sick from staying awake tonight.
sentences.ko: 오늘 밤 깨어 있는 바람에 몸이 상할 거예요.

speaker: CAPULET
raw:
No, not a whit. What! I have watch’d ere now
All night for lesser cause, and ne’er been sick.

sentences.en: No, not at all.
What!
I have watched all night before for smaller reasons.
sentences.ko: 전에도 이보다 사소한 일로 밤을 새웠지만

sentences.en: I was never sick then.

speaker: LADY CAPULET
raw:
Ay, you have been a mouse-hunt in your time;
But I will watch you from such watching now.

sentences.en: Yes, you were a real woman-chaser in your day.
But I will keep an eye on you now, so you do not stay up for that.
sentences.ko: 하지만 이제는 그런 일로 밤새지 못하게 제가 지켜볼 거예요.

raw: Exeunt Lady Capulet and Nurse.

speaker: CAPULET
raw: A jealous-hood, a jealous-hood!

sentences.en: Jealous, jealous!

raw: Enter Servants, with spits, logs and baskets.

sentences.en: Servants enter with spits, logs, and baskets.
sentences.ko: 종들이 꼬챙이와 장작, 바구니를 들고 들어온다.

speaker: CAPULET
raw: Now, fellow, what’s there?

sentences.en: Now, man, what is that?

speaker: FIRST SERVANT
raw: Things for the cook, sir; but I know not what.

sentences.en: These are things for the cook, sir.
But I do not know what they are.

speaker: CAPULET
raw: Make haste, make haste.

sentences.en: Hurry up. Move faster.

raw: Exit First Servant.

speaker: CAPULET
raw:
—Sirrah, fetch drier logs.
Call Peter, he will show thee where they are.

sentences.en: You there, go get drier logs.
sentences.ko: 거기 너, 가서 마른 장작을 가져와라.

sentences.en: Call Peter.
He will show you where they are.
sentences.ko: 그 애가 어디 있는지 알려 줄 거다.

speaker: SECOND SERVANT
raw:
I have a head, sir, that will find out logs
And never trouble Peter for the matter.

sentences.en: I have a head, sir.
I can find the logs myself.
I will not trouble Peter for it.

raw: Exit.

speaker: CAPULET
raw:
Mass and well said; a merry whoreson, ha.
Thou shalt be loggerhead.—Good faith, ’tis day.
The County will be here with music straight,
For so he said he would. I hear him near.

sentences.en: By God, well said.
You funny rascal, ha!
You will be head of the logs, you blockhead.
sentences.ko: 넌 장작 대장이다, 이 나무토막 같은 녀석아.

sentences.en: My goodness, it is day.
The Count will be here with music soon.
sentences.ko: 곧 음악과 함께 백작이 도착할 것이다.

sentences.en: He said he would come.
I hear him nearby.

raw: Play music.

sentences.en: The musicians play music.

speaker: CAPULET
raw: Nurse! Wife! What, ho! What, Nurse, I say!

sentences.en: Nurse! Wife! Hey!
Nurse, I say!

raw: Re-enter Nurse.

speaker: CAPULET
raw:
Go waken Juliet, go and trim her up.
I’ll go and chat with Paris. Hie, make haste,
Make haste; the bridegroom he is come already.
Make haste I say.

sentences.en: Go wake Juliet and help her get ready.
I will go and talk with Paris while you move fast.
sentences.ko: 나는 가서 패리스와 이야기하고 있을 테니, 서둘러라.

sentences.en: Move fast; the groom has already arrived.
I say, hurry!

raw: Exeunt.
